A NEPA Public Resource

Find Your Perfect Venue.

A free directory of pavilions, fire halls, parks, and community spaces across Northeast Pennsylvania — built as a resource for anyone planning a birthday, family reunion, fundraiser, or community event. Browse by category, tap a venue for full contact info, then reach out directly.

Verify before booking. Phone numbers, fees, and availability change. Always confirm directly with the venue before finalizing your event. Fire hall rental policies in particular vary widely — most are booked through individual fire companies and may require membership sponsorship for non-profit rates.

State, county & municipal parks

NEPA's outdoor venues — full-service state park pavilions with electric and water, county parks with reservable shelters, and free township picnic areas. Most state and county pavilions can be reserved up to 11 months in advance through the official park office.
